title: Page 32 red-edge terminal holdout eligibility audit

target.description: Whether any terminal-page feature remained independently withheld and predeclared for a valid test

summary: All six candidate terminal endpoints were ineligible because they were already used, lacked a predeclared decoder, or were not predicted by the frozen grammar.
why_run: To prevent a retrospective red-edge concordance from being strengthened with post-hoc mappings to already inspected solved-page features.

parameters.eligibility_requirement: independently withheld and predicted before plaintext inspection

pipeline.description: Audit each frozen candidate endpoint for independence and a predeclared decoder; count only eligible targets.

acceptance.criterion: At least one independently withheld, predeclared terminal endpoint exists.

controls: Targets already used to formulate the earlier interpretation are ineligible.
Features without a source-authorized predeclared decoder are ineligible.
interpretation: No new terminal feature may be scored under this route without inventing a decoder after inspection; the earlier concordance remains retrospective and cannot be upgraded by this audit.
limitations: This eligibility audit does not independently test the underlying retrospective concordance.
The forward next-slice instruction is excluded from the public package.

normalization_changes: Converted historical fields to the HMS run schema.
Preserved the contract, report, result, and eligibility ledger as normalized UTF-8 text.

raw_artifacts.reason: All evidence used for the eligibility conclusion is present; forward research instructions are withheld.
